evidence.note: DeepTumorVQA's ID mapping (GitHub branch v1, Data/AbdomenAtlas_ID_mapping.csv) covers exactly the 9,262 BDMAP IDs. For the mapped KiTS cases, the largest kidney lesion diameter in this release agrees with KiTS23's radiographic_size (correlation 0.97 for the KiTS21 rows and 0.84 for the KiTS23 rows; 0.16 or less when each scan is paired with the neighbouring case).

explanation: AbdomenAtlas 3.0 reuses KiTS'23 CT scans. Table 1 lists 489, and DeepTumorVQA's ID mapping names 300 KiTS21 and 189 KiTS23 scans, which together are the 489 KiTS23 training cases. Another 176 BDMAP IDs map to KiTS19-21 names and look like second copies of the same scans, so 665 BDMAP IDs hold 489 KiTS cases. Their patients are counted in both releases, so the counts must not be added. KiTS23 labels tumour and cyst separately. AbdomenAtlas 3.0 has a single kidney lesion mask per scan that does not say whether a lesion is a tumour or a cyst; whether KiTS23 cysts were kept in it is not documented.

evidence.locator: Table 1 (489 KiTS'23 scans); KiTS23 labels.py (separate tumor and cyst classes); mask_only listing (one kidney_lesion.nii.gz per case, no typed kidney files)
